archetypes.name: dyn-occurrence-baseline
archetypes.rationale: Occurrence codec path prefix mapping and deferred absent-baseline exit behavior are easy to get subtly wrong.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the occurrence baseline codec in engine.py and the markdown fence rule wiring. Verify JSON file values stay python-relative while Finding.path stays repo-relative, duplicate/stale/missing-reason handling stays fail-closed, and a clean scan with no baseline exits 0 while live findings without a baseline exit 2. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
